---
title: "Download a single folder from a GitHub repository"
description: " "
categories: [tips]
image: ../static/img/tips.png
order: 3
---

1. Go to the GitHub repo you would like to download the folder.  

For example: 
[https://github.com/le-huynh/writing_journal_article_in_rmarkdown](https://github.com/le-huynh/writing_journal_article_in_rmarkdown){target=_blank}

2. Replace `.com` with `.dev` in the URL to access the repository using [github.dev](https://github.com/github/dev){target=_blank} web-based editor.  

For example:
[https://github.dev/le-huynh/writing_journal_article_in_rmarkdown](https://github.dev/le-huynh/writing_journal_article_in_rmarkdown){target=_blank}

3. Within the `EXPLORER` panel (located on the left-hand side or accessed via <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>E</kbd>), right-click on the specific file or folder you need and choose the option `Download...`.

4. When prompted with the `Select Folder` dialog box, pick the directory on your computer where you'd like the chosen file or folder to be saved.
